question: In the middle of which century did the Arab traveler Sulaiman visit India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sulaiman**, also known as **Sulaiman al-Tajir**, visited India in the **9th century.**
 
• He was an Arab traveler and merchant who wrote about his travels in a book called **"Kitab al-Masalik wa al-Mamalik"** (Book of Roads and Kingdoms).
 
• Sulaiman's account of his journey provides valuable information about the **political, social, and economic** conditions of India during that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The **15th century** was a significant period in Indian history, marked by the rise of the** Vijayanagara Empire** and the arrival of the **Portuguese.**
 
• The **11th century** saw the reign of **King Rajendra Chola**, who expanded the Chola Empire through conquest and trade.
 
• The **6th century **was a time of political and social upheaval in India, with the **decline of the Gupta Empire** and the emergence of regional kingdoms.
